name: strata-v100-resident-2x-iq3s
description: IQ3_S on two V100-32G cards (volta05): does 54.8 GB of experts plus dense/KV stay fully resident in 64 GB, and what does the 2x vs 4x crossover look like at 1k-128k?

estimate.basis: two-card load plus ten cells; prefill at 128k dominates (about 3 x 50 s)

caveats: NEW DEFINITION, first run 2026-10-27. It must prove residency from the engine log (`100% of the experts resident`, `N of N profiled pairs`); if it streams, that is the crossover result, not a failed run.
The matrix runner uses --batch 2 for a C1/C2 ladder, while the 4x resident recipe used --batch 4; per-stream decode is not directly comparable across the two server shapes.
One allocation must own cards 0 and 1; the node is shared.
128k is the top of this ladder; 262k on 2x is not attempted (64 GB cannot hold the pack plus the 262k KV comfortably).
